**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)**

Article VIX contains no affirmative warranty at all — only an "AS IS" disclaimer that expressly sweeps in **express** warranties and states that Licensor does not warrant that nonconformity to the Documentation "CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED." That is the playbook walk-away position, so we redlined it:

1. **Inserted new § 9.1 (Limited Warranty)** — workmanlike performance of any services/support/implementation work; 12-month conformity of the Licensed Software to its Documentation; compliance with applicable laws; no malicious code — with a repair / replace / re-perform / refund remedy at Licensor's option.
2. **Narrowed the disclaimer** (p0110) with an "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THE LIMITED WARRANTY ABOVE" lead-in so the express warranty is not swallowed by the "express or implied" disclaimer.

Fallback flagged in the comment: 90-day conformity period with the same remedies.
